Pr22.Util

Class Frame

  • java.lang.Object
    • Pr22.Util.Frame

  • public class Frame
extends java.lang.Object
    Data for a quadrangle. A quadrangle is in normal orientation if the coordinates of its top left corner have the lowest values.
